The bruschetta, fresh spring rolls, spaghetti with tomato & garlic, and the special Vietnamese white coffee. Except the spaghetti, which was a bit underwhelming, rest everything was tasty. 'May' the owner was very warm & friendly. We also got to watch the iconic train pass by the street while enjoying our food there.
